title: Draw Canvas Light Mode And Document Dimensions
description: The draw canvas is too dark in light mode. Make it match other projects such as flow and infinite grid. Also show the document dimensions.
summary: Draw canvas in light mode now uses the same board palette clear (`rasterClear`) and LOD infinite grid as flow/infinite instead of a hardcoded dark fill/checkerboard (React + wgpu). Draw scenes emit the artboard paper plus a `W × H` dimension label; blank documents default to a 1024×1024 artboard. Also repaired concurrent WindowMeasure::Group initializer breakage in framework/plugin and framework/renderer/wgpu that blocked compile.
